dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately five prominent 'O' shaped annuli exhibit sharp pixel intensity gradients from a dark exterior background to a high-luminance white/grey perimeter; the geometry of these perimeters is irregular and non-concentric.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed in the anterior-dorsal region, interspersed between the more defined annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest mid-dorsal annuli form an asymmetrical trapezoidal polygon, while a secondary grouping of smaller blobs forms a linear arrangement towards the anterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-intensity white patch is visible on the snout, providing a singular high-contrast point at the anterior extremity.
